package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	gin "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for sql_query_text_asserted_in_handler_tests: SQL-shape assertions written at handler level instead of repository tests.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type mockDB struct {
	lastQuery string
}

func (m *mockDB) Query(query string, args ...interface{}) []map[string]interface{} {
	m.lastQuery = query
	return []map[string]interface{}{
		{"id": 1, "name": "alice"},
	}
}

func TestListUsersHandlerSQL(t *testing.T) {
	db := &mockDB{}

	router := gin.Default()
	router.GET("/users", func(c *gin.Context) {
		users := db.Query("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE tenant_id = $1", 42)
		c.JSON(http.StatusOK, users)
	})

	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/users", nil)
	router.ServeHTTP(w, req)

	expectedSQL := "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE tenant_id"
	if !strings.Contains(db.lastQuery, expectedSQL) {
		t.Fatalf("expected query containing %q, got %q", expectedSQL, db.lastQuery)
	}

	var users []map[string]interface{}
	json.Unmarshal(w.Body.Bytes(), &users)
	if len(users) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 user, got %d", len(users))
	}
}
